home_body:
Pick an algorithm, choose a sample dataset (or load a CSV), drop identifier columns if needed, enter parameters, then click Run.

Each computation step appears in RESULTS. Every page has pseudocode. ID3 and K-Means have a step-by-step demo and a result graph. Export as TXT.
about:
Educational data-mining demo (pure Python).
The console is the product — aligned step tables with color tags.
guide:
1. Choose an algorithm
2. Pick a dataset or load CSV
3. Drop identifier columns (pid/tid/id)
4. Enter parameters
5. Run and read the console
6. Open pseudocode / demo / result graph if available
7. Export TXT if needed
